item.description: Alabama, constituent state of the United States of America, admitted to the union in 1819 as the 22nd state. item.title: What is Alabama Known For? 25 Things AL is Famous For
item.description: Alabama is known for its history, especially its role in the Civil Rights Movement, along with its strong Southern culture, college football, and food. Places like the Edmund Pettus Bridge in Selma and the Civil Rights Memorial in Montgomery are some of the most well-known sites in the state.
